content.short: Experience the world of Cardano through the palm of your hand.
content.description:
VESPR is a non-custodial mobile light wallet for the Cardano network that prioritizes the security and safety of your digital assets without compromising on presentation. Your private keys and assets are always in your control.

We provide a highly intuitive UI to tailor both the look and feel of the app for any kind of user, whether you are an experienced investor, a Cardano aficionado, and even a novice looking to explore web3.

VESPR focuses on providing a lightning-fast and extremely reliable user experience so you can make transactions anytime, anywhere. Send, store, and receive Cardano native tokens, show off your NFT collection to your friends, connect to dApps, and carry the world of Cardano everywhere you go.
